    IN  p_email          VARCHAR(80),
    IN  p_nickname       VARCHAR(100),
    IN  p_password_hash  VARCHAR(255),

    IN  p_gender_ID      TINYINT UNSIGNED,
    IN  p_country_code   CHAR(2),
    IN  p_phone          VARCHAR(25),
    OUT p_user_id        INT
)
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO tb_users (email, nickname, password, creation_date, last_login, status)
    VALUES (p_email, p_nickname, p_password_hash, p_creation_date, p_last_login, p_status);

    SET p_user_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();

    INSERT INTO tb_people (user_ID, courtesy_title_ID, given_names, family_names,
                           birth_date, gender_ID, country_code, phone)
    VALUES (p_user_id, p_courtesy_title, p_given_names, p_family_names,

END ;;

    DECLARE v_user_id INT;

    -- Manejo de errores: Si ocurre una falla, deshace los cambios (ROLLBACK)
    DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION
